marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants & Southbound Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index closed higher led by Alibaba and Tencent following expanded share buyback execution and Southbound capital net inflows exceeding HKD 4.2 billion during the session.
marketLayer.inference: Continuous Southbound inflows combined with elevated corporate buybacks provide strong valuation support for major Chinese internet equities, helping offset broader domestic macro drag.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainment of capital inflow momentum post-earnings and potential renewal of regulatory or geopolitical noise.

marketLayer.title: US Megacap Tech & Semiconductor Hardware Momentum
marketLayer.fact: US tech hardware and semiconductor equipment stocks saw increased trading volume ahead of key earnings, driven by reports of persistent high-bandwidth memory (HBM) packaging tool demand.
marketLayer.inference: Hyperscaler capital expenditure on AI infrastructure remains firmly intact, maintaining a strong fundamental tailwind for upstream supply chain leaders despite broader consumer tech softening.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of software-layer AI applications and potential margin compression reported in upcoming quarterly earnings.

marketLayer.title: Chinese New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) & Export Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed EV leaders including BYD and Li Auto outperformed the broader market following strong preliminary July delivery projections and expanding overseas shipment data.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerating international sales are becoming a vital gross-margin driver, enabling market leaders to absorb intense domestic price competition better than tier-two peers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policy adjustments, European import tariff developments, and regional supply chain localization costs.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US 10-year Treasury yields stabilized near 4.18% as interest rate futures priced in a higher probability of a Fed interest rate cut at upcoming policy meetings.
marketLayer.inference: Easing long-term risk-free rates improves broader equity valuation multiples and helps ease Hong Kong dollar liquidity conditions, providing a boost to high-dividend Hong Kong shares.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected upside surprises in upcoming US inflation data (PCE/CPI) or sudden labor market weakness.
